text:
kevin: spotted a dup order from the quickstart sample when a 429 hit during token refresh. attaching repro.

maya: can you paste repro steps?

kevin: 1) run quickstart createOrder in loop until rate limit. 2) force background token rotation while backoff is waiting. 3) SDK refresh completes and retry sends request without idempotency header -> duplicate order.

oscar: quickstart intentionally omits idempotency to stay tiny. risky for side effects.

liz: proposed minimal change: add a one-liner helper and header in quickstart. keep collapsed by default. example: `const id = makeId(userId,payload); await client.createOrder(payload,{headers:{'Idempotency-Key':id}})`

maya: SDK idea: track if auth refreshed between attempts and mark retry as "refresh-triggered". only auto-replay if idempotency present or allowRefreshReplay=true. default allowRefreshReplay=true for convenience, but doc the strict flag.

ci-bot: CI note: adding e2e that simulates 429 + auth rotation (deterministic sleep) to catch regressions.

kevin: action items: @liz update quickstart, @maya open SDK proposal for allowRefreshReplay, @oscar add CI test. target: next sprint. :thumbsup:
